criteria.description: Lays out multiple distinct rollout stages (e.g. offline eval, shadow, dogfood, canary, staged GA) rather than a single launch or a plain percentage ramp.
Each stage has an explicit entry gate / promotion criterion based on what the previous stage measured.
Specifies a kill switch AND the defined fallback experience users get when the AI is disabled (not an error).
Pre-commits the specific (ideally numeric) metric breaches that trigger rollback, rather than deciding during an incident.
Includes a shadow / silent stage where output is generated on real traffic but not shown, to compare against baseline with no user risk.
Gates / monitoring cover quality AND cost AND latency, not quality alone.
Includes steady-state monitoring after GA and watches for gradual drift, plus an eval cadence — not just launch-day metrics.
